system.name: Llumnix
system.one_liner: a dynamic scheduling system for LLM serving that reschedules requests across instances via a two-level global/local scheduler and live migration

components.name: Global Scheduler
components.role: tracks per-instance memory loads and makes instance-oriented dispatch, migration-pairing, and auto-scaling decisions

components.name: New requests
components.role: incoming requests handled by the global scheduler for dispatch

components.name: Instance loads
components.role: periodic load reports from llumlets used for scheduling decisions

components.name: Local Scheduler
components.role: queues, batches, manages blocks, and calculates the instance's memory load; decides which requests to migrate

components.name: Migration Coordinator
components.role: coordinates with the local scheduler and the peer instance to execute request migration

components.name: llumlet
components.role: the per-instance dynamic scheduler pairing a local scheduler and migration coordinator

components.name: Executor
components.role: the model executor that performs inference and memory copying for migration on the GPU

components.name: Instance
components.role: a model-serving instance running an llumlet and executor

content.key_idea: Llumnix separates a lightweight global scheduler, which only reasons about instance-level memory loads, from per-instance llumlets that decide and execute request migration autonomously, enabling scalable continuous rescheduling.
content.reading_order: Top-down from the Global Scheduler box, following Dispatch/Report load arrows down into the left Instance's llumlet (Local Scheduler and Migration Coordinator) and Executor, then across (orange Trigger migration arrow) to the scaled-out Instances on the right.

summary: This figure presents the architecture of Llumnix, a dynamic scheduling system for LLM serving. A Global Scheduler at the top receives new requests and periodic instance load reports, and makes dispatch, migration-pairing, and auto-scaling decisions purely based on instance-level memory loads. Below it, each serving Instance runs an llumlet containing a Local Scheduler (handling queuing, batching, block management, and load calculation) and a Migration Coordinator (which executes migration by instructing the model Executor on the GPU). The figure shows one instance expanded in detail on the left, connected by Dispatch/Report load arrows to the Global Scheduler, and an orange Trigger migration arrow reaching across to additional, more schematically drawn Instances on the right that represent scale-out. A small legend distinguishes orange migration-control arrows from dashed other-control arrows. The style is a flat, hatch-filled architecture diagram in an orange/blue/green PowerPoint-like palette with dashed module boundaries.
summary_zh: 该图展示 Llumnix 的架构：顶部全局调度器根据各实例内存负载做出派发与迁移配对决策，每个实例内的 llumlet 由本地调度器和迁移协调器组成，协调器通过橙色箭头触发对执行器的实际迁移操作，右侧以简化实例表示可扩展性。
